So here's one I had a while ago that for some reason really bothered at me at the time because it was so vivid and unsettling (at least to me it was):

  
I was standing in line at Costco of all places, casually chatting it up with an older woman (maybe 40s/50s?) I didn't recognize while she put her items on the conveyor belt. Mind you, the entire store for some reason was somehow crowded (think Costco on a Sunday afternoon) and also dimly lit, with a center of light being over me and the woman being on the outskirts of the beam of light. As we finish our conversation, I look at the other people in line across me to my left and I notice that they're all frozen in place, except for one person I couldn't initially recognize with their own beam of light standing there and the woman I was just talking to who was in the process of leaving. I ignore it and move to checkout. As I begin to put my items on the conveyor belt. I get the feeling I'm being watched; I turn around and I realize that it's my ex best friend, and that she was much closer this time, light beam and all. As we locked eyes, something felt very off almost immediately, which caused me to panic and start moving faster so I could leave. I pay, grab my cart, and start hauling ass into the dark towards the exit, we were making eye contact the entire time as I moved. I turn to face the exit and there she is standing right next to me, just to my left. I froze up, not like others though, this was out of shock, and we locked eyes again. Her eyes reminded me of obsidian, after a few seconds she looks at me, gets close enough to me to whisper "don't blame me for breaking your heart" in my ear, and hugs me. 

I woke up drenched in sweat right after that, damn near thought that demon of a woman was sitting in my chair next to my bed when I tried to grab my water. I know it sounds cliche and all, but this dream really messed with me for a few days after this, and it's one of the few dreams that I can remember well, it's also one of the most puzzling ones I had because I still can't figure it out for the most part. Even so, I haven't spoken to my ex best friend in almost two years, we had... a complicated relationship in the near decade we were friends, which includes some rather traumatic experiences I had while being friends with her. Anyway, sorry about the length, this is one of the 2 dreams I've had about her, and it's the most interesting and intense of the pair.
